name: attempt
notes: For the 'told how, now try it' beat. LOOKS LIKE: the arm commits — rises, reaches well out and down (joint4 to -44), closes the jaws, then LIFTS 8 deg as if testing whether it got the thing, lets go, and withdraws. The test lift is the point: it reads as trying, not as succeeding. Nothing was taught from a demonstration and there is no perception in the loop, so it is trying a shape of motion, not verifying a grasp. Peak 13.3 deg/s. JOINT1 IS ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT. Operator instruction at the arm: there are clamps on the sides of the base, so the base does not turn — the collision model cannot see those clamps, so the person standing there is the authority. hw_backend refuses any stream moving joint1 more than 2 deg. All expressiveness is joint2-joint6 plus the jaws. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Full-range revision, authorized 2026-08-30 ('i want you to fully use the arm not just slightly move it'); budgets are measured with arm/measure_range.py and every stream is MuJoCo self-collision-verified before a frame is sent.

waypoints.label: test lift — did I get it?
